```{r set up day, include=FALSE}

todays_stage<-"stage-1"
route<-fread("/Users/jonathanderry/Documents/Home/Cycling/TDF_2026/Route_2026.txt")
route$Date<- gsub("26", "2026", route$Date) %>% as.Date(route$Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
date<-Sys.Date()
route_filtered<-route %>% dplyr::filter(Date<=date & Distance !="")
stages<-route_filtered$Details
course<-route %>% dplyr::filter(Details==todays_stage) %>% pull(Start.and.Finish)

Title<-route %>% dplyr::filter(Details==todays_stage) %>% pull(Stage) %>% paste("STAGE", ., sep=" ")
```

```{r Download daily data, include=FALSE}

#Stage_dates & route



daily_result<-data.frame()

for (i in 1:length(stages)){
  Stage_no<-stages[i]
  url_temp<-paste0("https://www.letour.fr/en/webview/rankings/",Stage_no,  "/true/itg?hasCookies=false&isWebview=true&isRacecenter=true")
  table_temp<-read_html(url_temp)  %>% html_elements("table") %>%  html_table() %>% as.data.frame()
  table_temp<-cbind(table_temp, Stage_no)
  daily_result<-rbind(daily_result, table_temp)
}

daily_result$Hour<-as.numeric(gsub("h.*", "", daily_result$Times))
daily_result$Minute<-  gsub(".*h ", "", daily_result$Times)
daily_result$Minute<-  as.numeric(gsub("'.*", "", daily_result$Minute))
daily_result$Second<-gsub(".* ", "", daily_result$Times)
daily_result$Second<-  as.numeric(gsub("''", "", daily_result$Second))
daily_result$total_seconds<-(daily_result$Hour*60*60)+(daily_result$Minute*60)+(daily_result$Second)

daily_result$time<-lubridate::seconds_to_period(daily_result$total_seconds)


name<-paste("Stages_master", as.character(Sys.Date()), sep="_")
assign(name, daily_result)

write.table(daily_result,file=paste("/Users/jonathanderry/Documents/Home/Cycling/TDF_2026/2026_Results/", stages, "_stages_master_",as.character(Sys.Date()),".txt", sep=""), sep="\t",  row.names = F)

#stages<-route %>% dplyr::filter(Date<=date & Start.and.Finish !="rest day" ) %>% pull(Details)

```

```{r Daily results table, include=FALSE}


df<-read_excel("/Users/jonathanderry/Documents/Home/Cycling/TDF_2026/Teams.xlsx", sheet="df1") 

daily<-daily_result %>% dplyr::filter(Stage_no==stages[length(stages)])


stage_df<-merge(df, daily, by.x="Rider_1", by.y="Rider", all.x=T) 


write.table(stage_df,file=paste("/Users/jonathanderry/Documents/Home/Cycling/TDF_2026/2026_Results/", Stage_no, "_results_",as.character(Sys.Date()),".txt", sep=""), sep="\t",  row.names = F)




competitors<-unique(stage_df$Name)


final<-data.frame()


for (i in 1:length(competitors)){
  temp<-stage_df[,-18] %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::filter(Name == competitors[i]) %>% dplyr::arrange(total_seconds,Rank, Rider_1)
  
  rider_1=temp[1,c(1,6,17)]
  rider_2=temp[2,c(1,6,17)]
  rider_3=temp[3,c(1,6,17)] 
  
  Average_Rank=round(mean(temp$Rank,na.rm=T),1)
  
  temp2<-cbind(competitors[i],unique(temp$Team.x),rider_1, rider_2, rider_3, Average_Rank )
  
  colnames (temp2)<- c("Name", "Team", "Rider1","Rider1_Rank", "Rider1_Time", "Rider2", "Rider2_Rank","Rider2_Time", "Rider3","Rider3_Rank", "Rider3_Time", "Average_Rank_All")
  
  temp2$Stage_Time_secs<-(temp2$Rider1_Time+temp2$Rider2_Time+temp2$Rider3_Time)
  
  temp2$Stage_Time<-lubridate::seconds_to_period(temp2$Rider1_Time+temp2$Rider2_Time+temp2$Rider3_Time)
  
  temp2$Rider1_Time<-lubridate::seconds_to_period(temp2$Rider1_Time)
  temp2$Rider2_Time<-lubridate::seconds_to_period(temp2$Rider2_Time)
  temp2$Rider3_Time<-lubridate::seconds_to_period(temp2$Rider3_Time)
  
  temp2$Average_Rank_top3<-round((temp2$Rider1_Rank+temp2$Rider2_Rank+temp2$Rider3_Rank)/3,1)
  
  final<-rbind(final, temp2)
  
}

final<-final %>% dplyr::arrange(Stage_Time, Average_Rank_top3, Average_Rank_All)

winning_time<-final$Stage_Time_secs[1]

final$Gap<-final$Stage_Time_secs-winning_time

final$Gap<-ifelse(final$Gap==0, "", final$Gap)

final$Gap<-ifelse(final$Gap=="", "", paste0("+ ", final$Gap, " secs"))

final$Position<-c("1st", "2nd", "3rd", "4th", "5th", "6th", "7th", "8th", "9th", "10th", "11th", "12th", "13th", "14th", "15th", "16th", "17th")

final<-final %>% dplyr::select ("Name","Team",  "Rider1","Rider1_Rank", "Rider2", "Rider2_Rank","Rider3","Rider3_Rank",  "Average_Rank_top3", "Average_Rank_All","Stage_Time", "Gap", "Position")

final$Gap[1]<-""

cols <- matrix("black", nrow(final), ncol(final))
cols[1,1:12] <- c("gold")
cols[2,1:12] <- c("grey70")
cols[3,1:12] <-c("#CD7F32")

cols2<-matrix("white", nrow(final), ncol(final))



t <- tableGrob(final[,-1], rows=NULL, theme = ttheme_default(colhead = list(fg_params = list(rot = 90,cex = 2)), core = list(fg_params = list(cex = 2.5,  col = cols, fontface="bold" ), bg_params=list(fill=cols2)), padding = unit(c(10, 12), "mm")))

title<-textGrob(paste(toupper(Stage_no), "Results Table", sep=" "), gp = gpar(fontsize = 30, fontface = "bold"))
t <- gtable_add_rows(t, heights = grobHeight(title) + unit(20, "mm"), pos = 0)
t<- gtable_add_grob(t, title, t = 1, l = 1, r = ncol(t))




ggsave(paste("/Users/jonathanderry/Documents/Home/Cycling/TDF_2026/2026_Results/", Stage_no, "_results_table_", as.character(Sys.Date()), ".jpg", sep=""),t, height=18, width=35, dpi=300,  units="in", bg = "white")



```

```{r create daily results figure v2, include=FALSE}


final$Team<-factor(final$Team, levels=c(rev(final$Team)))

final$Stage_Time_secs<-period_to_seconds(final$Stage_Time)

winning_time<-final %>% dplyr::arrange (Stage_Time_secs) %>% pull(Stage_Time_secs) %>% .[1]

final$Difference<-final$Stage_Time_secs-winning_time

final$keep<-if_else(final$Difference<(30*60), "keep", "drop")

final$Difference<-paste(final$Difference, "sec", sep=" ")


final2<-final %>% dplyr::select(Name, Team, Stage_Time_secs, Difference,Average_Rank_top3, Average_Rank_All, keep) %>% dplyr::ungroup(.)


winning_time<-final2 %>%  .[1,3]  
losing_time<-final2  %>% .[nrow(final2),3]
range<-losing_time-winning_time



final2$Difference<-final2$Stage_Time_secs-winning_time
final2$Percent<-(final2$Difference/range)*100
final2$differences <- c(0,diff(final2$Percent))

first_exceed_index <- which(final2$differences > 30)[1]
z<-ifelse(is.na(first_exceed_index) , length(competitors), first_exceed_index-1)
  
keep1<-c(rep("keep", z), rep("drop", length(competitors)-z))


final2$Difference<-seconds_to_period(final2$Difference)

duplicated<-duplicated(final2$Stage_Time_secs) 
small_increments <- seq(from =0.001, by = 0.001, length.out = sum(duplicated))

final2$Overall_Time2<-final2$Stage_Time_secs
final2$Overall_Time2[duplicated] <- final2$Overall_Time[duplicated] + small_increments

final_label_data<-final2 %>% dplyr::mutate(zoom = if_else(final2$keep=="drop",FALSE, NA ))
final_label_data<-final_label_data %>% dplyr::arrange(Stage_Time_secs, -Average_Rank_top3, -Average_Rank_All)



P1<-ggplot(final2, aes(x= Overall_Time2, y=1))+
  
  geom_point(color="white", alpha=0.1)+
  
  scale_x_reverse(breaks=final2$Stage_Time_secs, labels=final2$Difference)+
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0.15, 0) )+
  
  theme_light()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, face="bold", size=14, hjust=1))+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
       panel.background = element_blank())+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=20,hjust = 0.5, face="bold"))+
  
  geom_hline(yintercept=final2$Time,linetype="dotted", color = "black", linewidth=0.2 )+
  labs(x="", y="")+
  
  geom_image(data=final2[c(16:2),],aes(x= Stage_Time_secs, y=1, image = "/Users/jonathanderry/Documents/Home/Cycling/TDF_2026/Bikes/bike.png"), size = 0.18 )+ 
  geom_image(data=final2[c(1),],aes(x= Stage_Time_secs, y=1, image = "/Users/jonathanderry/Documents/Home/Cycling/TDF_2026/Bikes/first.png"), size = 0.165, nudge_y=0.01, nudge_x=0.1 )+
 geom_image(data=final2[c(17),],aes(x= Stage_Time_secs, y=1, image = "/Users/jonathanderry/Documents/Home/Cycling/TDF_2026/Bikes/last.png"),nudge_y=0.022, size = 0.18, nudge_x=-1 )+
```

```{r points table, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

results<-stage_df2


stages<-unique(results$Stage_no)


final<-data.frame()


for (i in 1:length(stages)){
 
  stage<-stages[i]
  
   temp<-results %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::filter(Stage_no == stages[i]) %>%  dplyr::group_by(Team.x)  %>% dplyr::arrange(total_seconds, Rank) %>% slice_head(n=3) %>% ungroup() %>% dplyr::group_by(Team.x) %>% summarise(Overall_Time=sum(total_seconds), top3_rank=mean(Rank))
  
  
  
  All_Rank=results %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::filter(Stage_no == stages[i]) %>%  dplyr::group_by(Team.x)  %>% dplyr::arrange(total_seconds, Rank) %>%  ungroup() %>% dplyr::group_by(Team.x) %>% summarise( all_rank=mean(Rank, na.rm=T))

  
  temp2<-merge(temp, All_Rank, by="Team.x")  %>% dplyr::arrange(Overall_Time, top3_rank, all_rank) %>% mutate(Stage=stage, Position=c("1st", "2nd", "3rd", "4th", "5th", "6th", "7th", "8th", "9th", "10th", "11th", "12th", "13th", "14th"))
  
final<-rbind(temp2, final)
  
}

podiums<-final %>% dplyr::group_by(Position, Team.x) %>% tally() %>% dplyr::filter(Position %in% c("1st", "2nd", "3rd")) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "Position", values_from = "n", id_cols = "Team.x")

#missing<-data.frame(Team.x=setdiff(unique(final$Team.x), podiums$Team.x), `1st`=NA, `2nd`=NA, `3rd`=NA)
#colnames(missing)=colnames(podiums)

#podiums<-rbind(podiums, missing)

podiums[is.na(podiums)]<-0

podiums$Score<-podiums$`1st`*10 + podiums$`2nd`*5 + podiums$`3rd`*2

podiums<-podiums %>% dplyr::arrange(-Score) %>% rename(Team=Team.x)



cols <- matrix("black", nrow(podiums), ncol(podiums))
cols[1,1:ncol(podiums)] <- c("seagreen")

cols2<-matrix("white", nrow(podiums), ncol(podiums))


t <- tableGrob(podiums, rows=NULL, theme = ttheme_default(colhead = list(fg_params = list(rot = 90,cex = 2)), core = list(fg_params = list(cex = 2,  col = cols, fontface="bold" ), bg_params=list(fill=cols2)), padding = unit(c(10, 12), "mm")))

title<-textGrob(paste( "Points Competition Standings after ", toupper(Stage),sep=" "), gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, fontface = "bold"))
t <- gtable_add_rows(t, heights = grobHeight(title) + unit(20, "mm"), pos = 0)

t<- gtable_add_grob(t, title, t = 1, l = 1, r = ncol(t))

caption_text <- textGrob("Points: 10 for 1st, 5 for 2nd, 2 for 3rd\n", 
                         gp = gpar(fontsize = 20), 
                         hjust = 1, x=0.95) # Adjust justification and position as needed


t<-grid.arrange(t, caption_text, 
             ncol = 1, 
             heights = unit.c(unit(1, "npc") - grobHeight(caption_text), 
                              grobHeight(caption_text)))


ggsave(paste("/Users/jonathanderry/Documents/Home/Cycling/TDF_2026/2026_Results/", Stage, "_overall_points_table_after_",  Stage,"_", Sys.Date(),".jpg", sep=""),t, height=15, width=12, dpi=1000,  units="in", bg = "white")
```
